rules.title: Sent from the deal's own account
rules.check: tx.account == eng.account && tx.innerAccounts().all(a, a == eng.account || (stage == 'open' && eng.parties.exists(k, eng.parties[k] == a)))
rules.message: The co-signer only signs transactions that move money out of this deal's single-use account, never anything that touches someone else's account.

rules.title: Allowed kinds of transaction
rules.message: Each step may only use the transaction types it needs (payments, closing the account…). Handing control of the account to a new key is never allowed.

rules.title: Network fee is reasonable
rules.message: The XRPL fee must stay under a cap, so a transaction can't quietly drain the account's XRP reserve.

rules.title: Expires quickly if not used
rules.check: stage in params.presignedStages || (tx.hasLastLedgerSequence && tx.lastLedgerSequence <= ledgerIndex + params.maxLedgerWindow)
rules.message: A live transaction must expire within a few ledgers (seconds), so a signed one can't be held back and used later. Pre-signed defaults are exempt; they're guarded by the other checks.

rules.title: All-or-nothing
rules.message: When several payments go together, either all of them happen or none do. No half-paid outcome is possible.

rules.title: Pays only people in the deal
rules.message: Money may only go to the guest, the hotel, the arbiters, or the service's fee account, never to an outsider.

rules.title: Closes the account cleanly
rules.message: Closing the account must pay out every last cent and then delete it. If the payouts don't add up to exactly what's in the account, it would leave money stranded.

rules.title: Says which outcome it is
rules.message: Every signed transaction carries a note naming the outcome it executes (agreed settlement, refund, ruling…), so the ledger history explains itself.

rules.title: No other outcome in progress
rules.message: Only one ending can be in flight at a time. If one was just signed and is still settling, a second one waits, so the deal can't be paid out twice.

rules.title: Right token issuer
rules.message: Every amount must be in the real RLUSD token from its official issuer, not a look-alike.

rules.title: The ledger would accept it right now
rules.message: Pre-signed endings can only be tried once: a failed attempt burns them. So the co-signer only signs one when the account is in exactly the state that makes it succeed, including being old enough to be deleted.
